exact_algorithm.estimator_purpose: one-dimensional monotone CART segmentation of the frozen OOF role score; squared-error split gain operationalizes algorithmic separation in the primary future target
exact_algorithm.minimum_share_gate: every tier share within position must be >= 0.05
exact_algorithm.target_monotonicity_gate: mean target_percentile must be non-decreasing from tier 0 through tier 6
exact_algorithm.tie_and_reproducibility_rule: use the deterministic scikit-learn best-split implementation under the pinned package versions; no manual threshold movement or alternate seed
exact_algorithm.tier_assignment: sort the six learned score thresholds ascending; assign each score to the number of thresholds it strictly exceeds, using numpy.searchsorted with side='right', producing tier indexes 0..6

interpretation_resolution.minimum_share_scope: within each position's development OOF rows
interpretation_resolution.reason: B41D fits a distinct model by position and the frozen target is a within-position percentile; therefore the seven contiguous role intervals are derived within the same position-specific score space.
interpretation_resolution.threshold_scope: separate deterministic threshold set for each position

scientific_parent.b41a_tier_plan: exactly seven ordered contiguous score intervals; algorithmically maximize separation in primary future target; minimum cell size and monotonicity constraints
scientific_parent.b41c_tier_policy: development OOF only; after model family frozen; minimum 5% development share per tier; monotonic future target; no hand-assigned thresholds
